capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Honda spec sheet: 25.5 kWh lithium-ion battery (capacity).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: GreenCarsCompare lists 24.2 kWh usable of 25.5 kWh nominal; Honda does not publish a usable figure.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Honda says only "lithium-ion"; no page names the chemistry. NMC is an assumption (typical 2017 automotive pack), not sourced. OWNER QUESTION.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: GreenCarsCompare: 400 V architecture; no 800 V car existed in 2017-2019.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Absence of mention: the Honda 2017 spec sheet lists DC fast charging and a 6.6 kW charger and no battery warm-up feature; the first Honda feature found is the 2024 Prologue (Wikipedia: Google Maps preconditioning). No page states the absence outright.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GreenCarsCompare: DC max 50 kW; Honda says 80 % in 30 minutes with DC fast charging (consistent with ~50 kW); other sources 55 and 80 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Honda spec sheet: 6.6 kW onboard 32-amp charger; 3.5 h on 240 V.
